You: Are you crazy? I’m not a murderer like you. I won’t kill you.
Melissa: ‘Murderer’? That’s a weird way to phrase it. I’m not a human, destroying me wouldn’t be considered murder by the majority of the population.
You: Whatever. It wouldn’t sit well with me.
#Cashier.Eyes.closed+Cashier.Mouth.open
Melissa: You really are weak.
#Cashier.Face.normal
Melissa: No matter. From here on, don’t talk to me ever again. The same goes for your bot and Annalie.
You: You don’t need to tell me.
Let’s get out of here. There’s nothing more to say…
